howItWorks.title: How iTRAIN works
howItWorks.subtitle: From initial diagnosis to professional export — a complete flow in 6 phases
howItWorks.step1_desc: Define the sport, competitive category, dominant physical capabilities and period objectives. The system adapts all parameters to your context.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Choose from 5 methodological models (Traditional, ATR, Blocks, Undulating, Concurrent). Configure the macrocycle with dates, competitions and phases.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Divide your plan into mesocycles with specific objectives and weekly microcycles. Assign volume, intensity and density loads per phase.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Create entities, teams and athlete profiles. Assign individual or collective plans. Control the physical profile and history of each athlete.
howItWorks.step5_desc: Capture each session with volume, intensity, RPE, exercises and methods. Compare planned vs. executed in real time.
howItWorks.step6_desc: Visualize ACWR, accumulated load, monotony and adherence. Generate professional reports in PDF/Excel. AI suggests smart adjustments.

models.title: 5 Methodological Models
models.subtitle: The system doesn't impose a model — you choose the right one
models.traditional_desc: Linear progression from volume to intensity. For developing athletes.
models.atr_desc: Sequential blocks: Accumulation, Transformation and Realization.
models.blocks_desc: Concentrated loads with high specificity. For elite athletes.
models.undulating_desc: Non-linear variation of load and intensity within the week.
models.concurrent_desc: Simultaneous development of multiple physical capacities.
